zh-Hans:
1.7.0（153）测试重点：
• 手记：导入课件、Pencil 书写、套索提问、保存回答与重开。
• 图文导图：动态排版、附图与文件、分支编辑、独立撤销、PDF 小窗与旋转。
• Office：保存恢复、PDF 导出、Word 批注和 PPT 放映，请反馈兼容问题。
• Whisper 语音、视频剪裁与字幕、图像工作台。
• 项目/会话包管理、自动浅深色主题、思考和工具折叠。
iPad 优先测试，同时检查 iPhone。永久删除需先进入回收站并确认；建议先导出 .floenote 备份。模型和软件包候选尚未全部交付，目录未就绪项不代表可用。真机验收由测试者完成。
en-US: Build 153: Test independent Notes, Pencil writing, selection questions, saved answers and reopening. Check dynamic illustrated maps, attachments, branches, independent undo and PDF windows in both orientations. Exercise Office save/recovery, PDF export, Word annotations and PPT presentation, and report compatibility issues. Try Whisper speech, video trim/captions, image editing, environment/package controls, automatic appearance and folded tool groups. Prioritize iPad and also check iPhone. Export an editable .floenote backup before confirming permanent deletion from Trash. Candidate package/model delivery remains incomplete; unavailable catalog entries are not installed capabilities. Physical-device acceptance is performed by testers.
